# Zachary Vorsteg

> Zachary Vorsteg is a technical founder based in West Palm Beach, Florida. He works on business operations, AI automation, custom software and financial systems, with selected work and a direct conversation path on his personal site. He is also a Florida-licensed real estate sales associate affiliated with Cornerstone Realty. Software and automation work is available remotely nationwide; property service areas depend on the engagement.

## Ways to work together

- [AI automation](https://zacharyvorsteg.com/ai-automation/): Intake, document work, reporting and connected workflows. Scope, timeline and ongoing responsibility are agreed before work starts.
- [Custom software](https://zacharyvorsteg.com/custom-software/): Applications, internal tools and integrations built around a defined business need.
- [Finance](https://zacharyvorsteg.com/finance/): Financial modeling, FP&A systems, scenario planning and pro formas.
- [Commercial real estate](https://zacharyvorsteg.com/commercial-real-estate/): Industrial, warehouse and flex property work through the applicable brokerage relationship.
- [AI Operating Layer](https://zacharyvorsteg.com/ai-operating-layer/): Direct involvement in the design and operation of business systems. Discuss fit, responsibilities and terms.
- [Production](https://zacharyvorsteg.com/production/): Selected reels, stills and motion work.
